svg.text: OSIRIS PDB REV A | TOP ASSEMBLY
JLCPCB prototype review | October 2, 2026 | Drawing enlarged; do not scale for fabrication
Orange dots = pad 1 on ICs, transistors, connectors, D3, C9 and C17 (pad 1 does not always mean +).
R17 / R18: DNP. F1: solder Keystone 3568 holder; insert the removable 7.5 A fuse after soldering.
Verify manufacturer library alignment and all polarity against Placement_Review.csv before ordering.
